teacher_info.introduction: HELLO, I'M JAMIE. I'm a native English speaker from the United Kingdom and I have a clear accent that is easy to understand. In the video above I speak quite quickly so don't worry if you didn't understand everything, that's why I'm here! From my own experience learning French and Spanish I can say that conversation is the best way to both reinforce everything you are learning and to find the places where you need to improve. It is also an opportunity to get away from the books and remind yourself that what you're learning is a real functioning language spoken by real functioning people ;) I'm able to adapt to a teaching style that suits you. We will talk about this in the first lesson and I will do my best to accommodate any requests you may have. Feel free to send me a message if you already know what you prefer. We will begin simply with conversation but there will be the opportunity to use any resources that you may want to bring to the lesson – songs, news articles or anything else easily accessible online or that you can send me before/during the lesson. I've recently bought a book called "Grammaire Anglaise", a book about English grammar written for French students of English. I will be studying this gradually and using it as a reference to enable me to offer better insights and more helpful explanations about the way the English language works. I have studied astrophysics at university level and have an understanding of a more academic use of English.. I also play the guitar. I'm more than happy to use the guitar as a focal point for lessons if you're also a guitarist – we can discuss our favourite musicians and steal each other's ideas ! *** IMPORTANT *** For the 5 lesson package: all 5 lessons must be taken within 3 weeks of me accepting the request :)

pro_course_detail.description:
This lesson is for students who would like to learn how to speak with a neutral British accent.

In each language from around the world particular letters are pronounced differently, emphasised or even completely absent from the alphabet. Due to this, as well as varying intonation, we can often guess the nationality of somebody whilst they speak English.

If you book this lesson I will identify the areas you need to improve on and teach you how to speak either more neutrally or with a British accent. During the first lesson we will have a casual conversation, which with your permission I will record, so that I am able to analyse your speech in greater detail later on. Alternatively you can record yourself reading out a text and send it to me.  Within 4 days I will send you a summary explaining which letters you have difficult pronouncing and any other aspects that are preventing you from sounding like a native.

In the following lessons I will help you overcome these difficulties.

pro_course_detail.description:
Exam Preparation Classes:
Training for English examinations. 

We will practise listening, speaking, reading and writing in the context of the exact examination requirements. 

Sessions are personalised to help you achieve the score you require.

You will be given practice tests so you can check your progress. 

Exams are stressful and difficult. I will give you lots of support to help minimise this stress and make you feel confident and comfortable when taking the exam. 


Please note: I will not be able to give you a grade for your work because I am not an examiner. I can however give you the best preparation possible for the exam so that you go into the test  fully aware of what you have to do. I have worked  with many students and can give you an indication of your English level but I cannot guarantee that you will achieve a score that matches this level in an exam.

Business English:

This class is designed to help professionals to develop their business communication skills. 

I have worked with CEOs, Scientists, Lawyers, Doctors and Project Managers to help them communicate as well in English as they do in their native languages. 

We will: 

Role play business phone calls, presentations, negotiations, meetings, etc. 

Study business language such as phrasal verbs and idioms that are commonly used in the UK/USA. 

Learn about formal and informal language.

Review business emails that you have sent. 

Develop templates for emails that you often send to colleagues/customers. 

Learn how to be both polite and direct in English. 

Work on your listening, reading, speaking, and writing skills.

Enhance your knowledge of grammar/vocabulary in the context of business topics. 

Each lesson is designed to meet your needs as a professional so that you leave the lesson one step closer to achieving your language goals.
